name: paper_pulse_train
description: Reduced HPPC-like pulse train: one pass, one temperature, one pulse amplitude -- charge-transfer and contact/ohmic resistance characterization
comment: Run after a full charging + 30 min resting. Eight repeats of: 1C discharge for 6 min, 20 min rest, 10s 1C discharge pulse, 5 min rest, 10s 1C charge pulse, 5 min rest. Charge and discharge commands are independently capped to the selected cell's limits. The EBC reports at about 1Hz, so it cannot resolve sub-second voltage steps; use faster equipment if clean instantaneous-resistance separation is required.
